bilgi.kurulumBaslatildi: Installation started — wait for your phone's confirmation. If you cancel, you can try again from this screen.
bilgi.seansSuruyor: The update was downloaded, but a session is in progress on the device (a session or running coil) — the installer was not opened. After the coils stop, tap 'Update'; the package is ready and will not be downloaded again.

hata.eksik: The download is incomplete. Check your connection and try again.
hata.indirilemedi: The update could not be downloaded. Check your connection and try again.
hata.izinGerekli: Permission is required to install. Allow this app on the screen that opens, then try again.
hata.sunucu: The update package cannot be reached right now (server error). It is not a problem with your connection; try again shortly.

indirmeBildirimiMetin: The package is downloading in the background; you can close the app.
